scenes.say: Seven years together, and that's it. Oscar Piastri has split with his manager Mark Webber.
It was announced on the Monday after the São Paulo Grand Prix. Both sides agreed.
Webber and his wife Ann managed him from twenty nineteen. Then two titles in a row, Formula Three and Formula Two.
In twenty twenty-two Alpine announced him. Oscar said no, and the FIA backed his McLaren contract.
A driver's manager negotiates contracts, finds sponsors and looks after the driver's image.
This season Webber worked behind the scenes and rarely came to races. Piastri is seventh right now.
Who manages Piastri next hasn't been announced. The driver standings are on LapRadar.

title: Piastri and Webber split: seven years, two titles and a contract fight
